args.content:
HAWAII VACATION PACKING LIST
June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel insurance documents
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and charger
- Portable power bank
- Travel adapter (if needed)

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (at least 2 sets)
- Light, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners
- Light jacket or sweater (for cooler evenings)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops/beach sandals
- Hat with brim for sun protection
- Sunglasses

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Beach towel
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- After-sun lotion or aloe vera
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Beach bag
- Water bottle

HIKING & OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES:
- Hiking boots or sturdy shoes
- Moisture-wicking socks
- Lightweight hiking pants/shorts
- Quick-dry t-shirts
- Rain jacket (for unexpected showers)
- Daypack/backpack
- Insect repellent

PERSONAL CARE:
- Toiletries (travel-sized)
- Prescription medications
- First aid kit
- Hand sanitizer
- Lip balm with SPF
- Hairbrush/comb
- Travel laundry detergent (for hand washing)

ACTIVITY-SPECIFIC ITEMS:
- Pearl Harbor visit: Respectful attire (covered shoulders, no shorts)
- Luau: Optional aloha shirt or dress
- Spa day: Nothing needed (provided by spa)
- Shopping day: Reusable shopping bags

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Books or e-reader
- Travel pillow
- Snacks for day trips
- Small umbrella
- Ziplock bags (for wet items or electronics protection)
